visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a bright pink puffy coat and a white hat with large, floppy animal ears stands in a snowy garden. She holds up a white t-shirt and smiles warmly at the camera. The background consists of bare trees and a wooden fence covered in light snow. (2) The woman kneels beside a small garden pond that appears partially frozen. She dips the white shirt into a bright yellow plastic bucket placed on the snowy ground. (3) She stands up and hangs the wet white t-shirt on a clothesline between wooden posts. The lighting is natural and overcast, typical of a winter day. (4) A close-up shot shows the bottom edge of the white t-shirt hanging on the line. Small icicles have formed and are dripping from the hem. (5) The woman removes the shirt from the line, and it remains perfectly rigid and horizontal, frozen solid like a piece of cardboard. She holds it out with both hands, showing its stiffness. (6) She attempts to fold the frozen shirt by pressing it against her knee. The rigid fabric eventually snaps, leaving a large, jagged hole in the center of the t-shirt. She laughs and looks at the camera.
